newsitem.title: GREECE: Alpha Trust-Hambros funds to expand activities.
newsitem.headline: Alpha Trust-Hambros funds to expand activities.

text.p: The teaming up of Hambros Hellenic Fund Management with Alpha Trust has sparked moves to expand the range of activities.

"Our goal for the coming years is the expansion of our Private Banking department and the provision of investment services to domestic and international institutions through Alpha Trust," said Hambros Fund Management in a statement.

Alpha Trust, under the Hambros umbrella since 1995 and Greece's first Investment Services company (EPEY) since November 1996, has supported the investment strategy of Hambros mutual funds in Greece, it said.
Hambros Fund Management announced it would rename all eight funds it manages into Alpha Trust-Hambros.

The Alpha Trust-Hambros group currently employs 31 people and has over 65 billion drachmas under management. Its net worth amounts to 470 million drachmas and produced pre-tax earnings of 130 million in 1996.
